info.name: Microsoft Purview Data Map API
info.description:
APIs for accessing and managing the unified data map that provides a holistic view of your data estate. Supports entity management, lineage tracking, relationship mapping, and discovery queries across cataloged assets. Built on Apache Atlas.

Contact Support:
 Name: Microsoft Purview Support
